name: showrunner
description: Agent orchestration tool: runs blueprints, records every event into SQLite, corrects and pauses agents via typed envelopes and gates.

scripts.postinstall: bun install --cwd packages/core && bun install --cwd packages/daemon && bun install --cwd packages/cli && bun install --cwd packages/starter-kit && bun install --cwd packages/ui
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc -p packages/daemon/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc -p packages/starter-kit/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun test packages/core/test packages/daemon/test packages/cli/test packages/starter-kit/test && bun test --cwd packages/ui test
scripts.build: echo 'no build step - bun runs TypeScript source directly'
